title: Top Vatican Official Calls Pope Leo's Lung Cancer Diagnosis 'a Bit of a Gamechanger'
detail: Archbishop Paul Gallagher, the Holy See foreign minister, called Pope Leo XIV's lung cancer diagnosis "a bit of a gamechanger" for the papacy, saying some had seen Leo as a "Superpope" and the illness shows he is "a poor mortal like the rest of us" (reported Oct 27). Subsequent tests indicated no further treatment is necessary, and the Vatican confirmed the South America trip proceeds unchanged.

media.caption: Top Vatican official says pope's cancer diagnosis a game changer for the papacy
